book.name: Luk
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Luk Le Rorori

content: Kaiwae gharɨgharɨ lemoyo vama thɨ rorinjoŋa bigibigike wolaghɨye iyava thɨ yomara e tɨnemike kaiwanji.

Vambe thɨ ghambu vara thavala va thɨ thuwe e maranjiko lenji utuutuko. Na kaiwae va thɨ thuwe e maranji mbaŋaniye va i woraweya le kaiwo rɨghewe, na thiye ŋgoranjiya Loi le utuutu gharakakaiwo, iyava thɨ utugiya utuutuke thiyake weime.

Iya kaiwae mbe ghino womberegha vara ya ghatha vakatha bigibigike wolaghɨye thiyake va i woraweya rɨghekowe. Nuwaŋguiya ya ghatha na ya bigirawe na vakatha na ya rorinjoŋa ghen giya laghɨye Tiyopilos kaiwan.
Ya vakatha iyake na mbala u ghareghare bigibigina va thɨ vaghareŋgena i emunjoru.
Nyao thovuye i yomara weya Sakaraiya
Mbaŋa Herod va ghambaŋa kiŋ Judiya, amala regha va ravowovowo idae Sakaraiya na iye i mena Abaija ele wabwi tɨne. Levo idae Elisabet na elaghɨniye Eron rumbuye.
Vambe theghewo vara ghanjithanavu i rumwaru Loi e marae na va thɨ ghambugha Loi le mbaro na ghathanavu.
Mava e lenji ŋgaŋga kaiwae Elisabet va i kwama na vama thɨ thanja moli.
Mbaŋa Sakaraiya le wabwi ghanjimbaŋa kaiwo, amalaghɨniye vambe inawe i vakavakatha ravowovowo ghanjikaiwo Loi e marae.
Kaiwae ravowovowo mbe ghanjithanavu ŋgoreiye, thɨ mwadiwo e varɨ
na i nja weya Sakaraiya, ve ru e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne na i ŋambu inisenɨs
na i vowo weya Loi.
Mbaŋa inisenɨs ghambaŋa ŋambu wabwi laghɨye mbe inanji eto thiya naŋgo.
Loi le nyao thovuye regha i yomara weya Sakaraiya e mbaŋako iyako na i ndeghathɨ inisenɨs ghaghamba ŋambuŋambuko valɨvaŋga e uneko.
Mbaŋa Sakaraiya i thuwe nyaoko thovuye ghare i yo weiye le gharelaghɨlaghɨ.
Ko iyemaeŋge nyaoko thovuye i dagewe iŋa, “Sakaraiya, tha u mararu, kaiwae Loi kaero i wovatha len naŋgona. Len wevo Elisabet ne i vaidiya ŋgama ghɨmoru na ne u rena idae Jon.
Ne hu warari laghɨye moli weiye lemi nuwathovuye na le ghambɨ ne i vakathaŋgiya gharɨgharɨ lemoyo thɨ warari.
Na idae ne i laghɨye Loi e marae, na Nyao Boboma ne i riyevanjara mbaŋa amba mane i virɨ, na mane i muna waen o the mbwa i vurɨgheghe.
Na Isirel gharɨgharɨniye thɨ ghanagha, ne i vaŋgunjoghaŋgi weya Giya lenji Loi.

Ne i viva Giya e ghamwae, ghathanavu na le vurɨgheghe ne ŋgoreiya Ilaija. Ne i vakathaŋgiya gamagai oramanji gharenji weŋgiya lenji ŋgaŋga na i vabe thavala ma thɨ ghambu Loi le renuwaŋa na thɨ ghambugha gharɨgharɨ rumwarumwaruniye lenji renuwaŋa na i vivathara weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ Giya le mena kaiwae.”
Amba Sakaraiya i dage weya nyaoko thovuye iŋa, “Ŋgoroŋga ne yaŋa na ya ghareghare iyake emunjoru? Kaiwae kaero ya thanja moli na lo wevoko tembe ŋgoreiyeva.”
Nyaoko thovuye i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Ghino Gaberiyel na ya ndeghathɨ Loi e ghamwae. Me variyeŋgo na ya mena ya utu e ghen na ya utuveŋga totoke thovuye iyake.

Wo u thuwe kaiwae ma mo loŋweghathɨgha lo utuke, amba mane e ghalɨghalɨŋan na mane valɨkaiwan u utu ghaghada mbaŋaniye bigibigike thiyake ne thɨ yomara ŋgoreiya ma utugiyama e ghen ne e ghanjimbaŋa moli.”
E mbaŋako iyako gharɨgharɨma thɨ roroghagha weya Sakaraiya na thɨ rerenuwaŋa thɨŋa, “Buda kaiwae i wo mbaŋa molao e Ŋgolo Bobomako tɨne?”
Mbaŋa i raŋgi, ma valɨkaiwae i utu weŋgi na kaero thɨ ghareghare me vaidiya vatomwe regha e Ŋgolo Bobomako tɨne. Ma vama i utu, vama i vakatha eŋge nono weŋgi e nɨmanɨmae.
Mbaŋa ghambaŋa kaiwo iko e Ŋgolo Bobomako tɨne, kaero i njogha ele ŋgolo.
Mava mbaŋa bwagabwaga levo Elisabet i marabo na manjala umbolima e tɨne vambe i rokubaro vara e lenji ŋgoloko tɨne.
Elisabet iŋa, “E mbaŋake iyake Loi kaero i thalavuŋgo e kamwathɨke iyake. Giya kaero i thalavuŋgo na i wokiyathu lo monjina gharɨgharɨ e maranji.”
Nyao thovuye i mena weya Meri
Ghamanjala umbowonaninji e tɨne, Loi i variya nyao thovuye Gaberiyel Nasaret, Galili ele valɨvaŋga tɨne,
weya thɨnabwethubwethuru eunda vama ghadagerawe weiye amala regha idae Josep iye Deivid rumbuye. Thɨnabwethubwethuruke idae Meri.
Nyaoko thovuye i wa na ve dagewe iŋa, “Ago Meri, Giya ghare laghɨye e ghen na iye wein.”
Meri i gharelaghɨlaghɨ laghɨye nyaoko thovuye ghalɨŋaewe na i rerenuwaŋa laghɨye dagemwaewoko iyako kaiwae.
Ko iyemaeŋge nyaoko thovuye i dagewe iŋa, “Tha u mararu, Meri, Loi i woraweŋge e ghamwae.
Ne u marabo na u ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru na ne u rena idae Jisas.
Ne i laghɨye moli na ne thɨ uno, Ramevoro Moli Nariye. Giya Loi ne i wogiya weya rumbuye Deivid le ghamba yaku,
na ne i mbaro Jeikob orumburumbuye weŋgi na le ghamba mbaro mane ele ghambako.”
Meri i vaito nyaoko thovuye iŋa, “Ne ŋgoroŋga na ya vaidiya ŋgama amba thɨnabwethubwethuruya ghino?”
Nyaoko thovuye i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Nyao Boboma ne i nja e ghen na Ramevoro Moli le vurɨgheghe i yaboŋge. Iya kaiwae ne u ghamba narunɨna boboma, ne idae Loi Nariye.
Wo u thuwe, u renuwaŋakikiya len bodama Elisabet, kaero i thanja na va thɨŋa i kwama, kaero i marabo na mbaŋake ghamanjala umbowona.
Kaiwae ma bigi regha i vuyowo weya Loi valɨkaiwae Loi i vakatha.”
Meri i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Giya le rakakaiwo ghino. Ma i vakathaeŋge ŋgoreiya mo utuŋana e ghino.” Amba nyaoko thovuye i iteteŋa.
Meri ve thuwe Elisabet
E mbaŋako iyako Meri i vivatha, na i yoruku i wa e ghemba regha e ououniye Judiya e tɨne.
I vutha na i ru Sakaraiya ele ŋgolo na i dage mwaewo weya Elisabet.
Mbaŋa Elisabet i loŋweya Meri le dagemwaewo ŋgamako i ghenenyivɨ e ŋgamoiye na Nyao Boboma i riyevanjara Elisabet.
I dage na ghalɨŋae laghɨye iŋa, “Wanakauke wolaghɨye e tɨnenji Loi ghare e ghen na ghandagemwaewona i kivwala wanakauke wolaghɨye ghanjidagemwaewo, na tembe ghare weva ŋgamana ne u ghambɨna.
Ko me ŋgoroŋgaeŋge na ghen wo Giya tɨnae mo vakatha wo yavwatata laghɨye na mo mena u thuweŋgo?
Mbaŋa len dagemwaewona me dimban e yanawaŋgu, ŋgamake e ŋgamoiŋguke i ghenenyivɨ weiye le warari.
Ŋgoreiye, u warari kaiwae u loŋweghathɨgha ŋgoroŋga Giya le dagerawe e ghen kaero ne i tabo na emunjoru.”
Meri i tarawe Loi
Meri iŋa,

content.text: Ghareŋguke i taraweŋa Giya,
na uneŋguke i warari laghɨye weya Loi wo Ravamoru,
kaiwae i renuwaŋakikiya le rakakaiwo ma e idaidae.
Noroke na mbaŋa thɨ menamenako tha na tha ne thɨ uno idaŋgu, “Wevo warawarariniye”,
kaiwae Loi Vurɨgheghe i vakatha bigibigi laghɨlaghɨye kaiwaŋgu.
Iye ghamberegha i boboma.
Le ghare vɨrɨ i laghɨye weŋgiya tha na tha thavala thɨ yavwatatawana.
E nɨmae i vakatha vakatha laghɨlaghɨye moli na i vagegeyathuŋgiya thavala thɨ wovorevoreŋa ghanjimberegha e gharenji.
Kaerova i wonjoŋaŋgiya giyagiya laghɨlaghɨye e ghambanji na i wovoreŋaŋgiya thavala ma e idaidanji.
I giya bigibigi thovuthovuye weŋgiya thavala bada i gharɨŋgi na i vathaŋgiya ravwenyevwenye nɨmanɨmanji.
Kaerova i mena i thalavugha le rakakaiwo wabwi Isirel,
na ma i renuwaŋa valawe i gharevɨrɨŋaŋgi,
ŋgoreiya va le dagerawe weŋgiya orumburumbunda,
ŋgoreiya va le dagerawe, iya i gharevɨrɨ weŋgiya Eibraham na orumburumbuye tha na tha.

content: Meri va i yaku weiye Elisabet mbaŋa le molamolao ŋgoreiya manjala umboto amba i njogha e ghambae.
Jon Rabapɨtaiso le virɨ
Mbaŋa Elisabet ŋgamoiye i njivun, i ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru,
na mbaŋa ghaune na le bodaboda thɨ loŋweya ŋgoroŋga Giya i woraŋgiya le gharevɨrɨ laghɨye weya Elisabet, thɨ warari laghɨye weinji.
Mbaŋa theghewaninji e tɨne thɨ mena na thɨ kitena ŋgamako riwae njimwae mbothiye na thɨ munje thɨ rena idae Sakaraiya, ramaya idae.
Ko iyemaeŋge tɨnae ghalɨŋae i maya na iŋa, “Nandere! Idae Jon.”
Thɨ dagewe thɨŋa, “Ma lolo regha len bodabodake e tɨnenji idae ŋgora iyana.”
Thɨ vakatha nono weya ramae na nuwanjiya the ida ne i worawe na ŋgamako idae.
Sakaraiya i naŋgo weya bigi ghamba rorori na i roriya iyake, “Idae Jon.” Na taulaghɨko gharenji i yo.
E mbaŋako vara iyako Sakaraiya ghalɨŋae i mavu na mamiye i nyivɨnyivɨ amba i utu na i taraweŋa Loi.
Ghanjiuneko wolaghɨye thɨ thuwe iyako na i vakatha thɨ gharelaghɨlaghɨ laghɨye moli. Amba bigibigike wolaghɨye thiyake utuninji i lalo ghembaghembako wolaghɨye e ououninji Judiya e tɨne.
Gharɨgharɨko wolaghɨye va thɨ loŋweya totoko iyako thɨ rerenuwaŋa kaiwae na thɨŋa, “Ŋgoroŋga nevole ŋgamako iyako gharerenuwaŋa? Kaiwae vambe weiya vara Giya le vurɨgheghe.”
Sakaraiya i tarawe Loi
Nyao Boboma va i riyevanjara ramae Sakaraiya amba i utuŋa Loi ghalɨŋae iŋa:

content.text: “Ra taraweŋa Giya iye Isirel lenji Loi,
kaiwae kaero menda i mena ghinda
le gharɨgharɨ kaiwanda, i thalavuinda na i rakayathuinda,
na i wogiya vamoru ghakin mara mbouye kaiwanda
le rakakaiwo Deivid orumburumbuye e tɨnenji.
Mbaŋa va i vivako ghalɨŋae gharautu boboma thɨ vathiya utuutuke iyake,
va i dagerawe ghandaravamoru na ne i vamoruinda
weŋgiya ghandathɨghɨya,
na thavala thɨ botewoinda e nɨmanji ghare.
Va iŋa ne i gharevɨrɨŋaŋgiya orumburumbunda
na i renuwaŋakikiya le dagerawe boboma.
Va i tholo na i dagerawe weya rumbunda Eibraham
na iŋa ne i vamoruinda weŋgiya ghandathɨghɨya
na i vakathainda rakaiwowe ma weinda la mararu
e yawalɨ boboma na e thanavu rumwaru e marae e mbaŋake wolaghɨye.
Ghen, naruŋgu, ne idan Ramevoro Moli ghalɨŋae gharautu,
kaiwae ne u viva Giya e ghamwae na u vivatha kamwathɨ kaiwae.
Na kaiwae ne u vakathaŋgi thɨ ghareghareya Giya le vamoru, na
i numotenɨŋgi lenji tharɨ e tɨne,
kaiwae Loi i gharevɨrɨ laghɨye moli na ghathanavu i udauda kaiwanda,
na i vakatha manjamanjala ŋgoreiya varaema i yovoro na manjamanjalawae i njama weinda e buruburuko
na i giya manjamanjala weŋgiya thavala thɨ yayaku e momouwo na yawalinji i mare,
na i vatomwe weinda yawalɨ na vanevane ghanjikamwathɨ.”

content: Ŋgamama i tabotabo na une i vurɨvurɨgheghe na ve yaku e njamnjam ghaghada mbaŋa i woraweya le kaiwo rɨghe weŋgiya wabwi Isirel.

footnotes.text: Inisenɨs iye umbwa thiye butiye thovuye na modanji laghɨye moli.
